description: Stop the FCM token + users/{uid} Firestore doc from being rewritten on every login/startup (audit Root Causes #3, #4, #5). Three unconditional writes: (a) frontend FcmService.init() calls getToken()+register-token on EVERY entry to /home with no cache comparison (home_shell.dart initState runs on every /home); (b) backend userRepository.ensureAccount writes users/{uid} with updatedAt=serverTimestamp() on every /api/auth/verify even when email/emailVerified are unchanged (createdAt is correctly written once and must stay that way); (c) backend userRepository.addFcmToken writes updatedAt=serverTimestamp() on every /api/notifications/register-token even when the token is already present. Make all three conditional. Doc id == Firebase UID is stable and correct — do NOT change identity mapping. This feature is INDEPENDENT of FEAT-001 (touches different files).
steps: Frontend (Root Cause #3): give FcmService access to SharedPreferences (inject via fcmServiceProvider using sharedPreferencesProvider). In init(), after getToken(), read the last-registered token from a prefs key (e.g. 'fcm_last_registered_token') and only POST /api/notifications/register-token when the fetched token differs from the cached one (or no cache exists); on success, store it. Keep the onTokenRefresh handler but have it register+cache only on actual change, and ensure the listener is attached once per app run (guard against re-subscription when HomeShell.initState runs again).

Frontend: if HomeShell re-entry can call init() repeatedly, add an idempotency guard in FcmService (e.g. a bool _initialized) so listeners are not stacked; keep the existing best-effort try/catch in home_shell.dart.

Backend (Root Cause #4): in backend/src/repositories/userRepository.ts ensureAccount, in the existing-doc branch, compare incoming email/emailVerified against snap.data() and only call set(patch,{merge:true}) with a fresh updatedAt when a tracked field actually changed; if nothing changed, skip the write and return the existing account data. Never rewrite createdAt. Preserve the created:false return contract.

Backend (Root Cause #5): in addFcmToken, only write (arrayUnion + updatedAt bump) when the token is not already present in the stored fcmTokens array; read the doc (or use a transaction) to check. If already present, make it a no-op. Keep removeFcmToken behavior.

Add/extend backend tests under backend/src/__tests__ (vitest) to cover: ensureAccount does not write when email/emailVerified unchanged (and does write when changed, without touching createdAt); addFcmToken is a no-op when the token already exists. Mock getFirestore()/admin as the existing tests/config allow; model the harness on middleware.test.ts. If Firestore cannot be mocked cleanly, at minimum assert the conditional logic via a thin unit around the comparison.

Add a frontend unit test for FcmService that mocks FirebaseMessaging, ApiClient, and SharedPreferences (mocktail) to assert register-token is NOT posted when getToken() returns the already-cached token, and IS posted on first registration / on change.
acceptance_criteria: Backend: from backend/, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass; new/updated tests prove ensureAccount skips the write when nothing changed (createdAt never rewritten) and addFcmToken is a no-op for an already-present token.
Frontend: from frontend/, `flutter analyze` passes and `flutter test` passes, including a test proving the client does not re-POST register-token for an unchanged cached token.
On an unchanged reopen/login there are no Firestore writes to users/{uid} from verify and no register-token POST from the client; the same UID still maps to the same users/{uid} doc.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED and GREEN. Backend: typecheck clean, `npm test` 86/86 pass (15 files) incl. 7 new userRepository tests. Frontend: `flutter analyze` no issues; `flutter test` 70/70 pass incl. 4 new fcm_service tests. FEAT-001 (independent) left untouched; only shared file touched by both features is notification_providers.dart indirectly? No — FEAT-001 touched auth files only, FEAT-002 touched fcm/user files only, no overlap.

Root Cause #3 (frontend FCM churn) — frontend/lib/core/services/fcm_service.dart: ctor now takes SharedPreferences (FcmService(this._api, this._notifications, this._prefs)). Added `bool _initialized` idempotency guard: init() returns early if already run, so HomeShell.initState re-entry (every /home entry) no longer re-requests permission, re-attaches onMessage/onTokenRefresh listeners (no stacking), or re-POSTs. getToken result and onTokenRefresh now go through new `_registerTokenIfChanged(token)` which reads prefs key 'fcm_last_registered_token' and POSTs /api/notifications/register-token ONLY when the fetched token differs from the cached one, caching it on success (not cached if POST throws, so a failed register retries next run). unregister() now also removes the cached key so a later sign-in re-registers. Added `@visibleForTesting registerTokenIfChanged` delegating to the private method so the conditional logic is unit-testable without the FirebaseMessaging platform channel. Wiring: frontend/lib/features/notifications/notification_providers.dart fcmServiceProvider now injects ref.watch(sharedPreferencesProvider) (imported shared_prefs_provider.dart). home_shell.dart unchanged (its existing best-effort try/catch around init() is preserved; the guard lives in FcmService).

Root Cause #4 (backend ensureAccount) — backend/src/repositories/userRepository.ts: existing-doc branch now reads snap.data(), compares incoming email/emailVerified against stored values, and only set(patch,{merge:true}) with a fresh updatedAt when email or emailVerified actually changed; otherwise returns {account: existing, created:false} with NO write. createdAt is never in the patch and is never rewritten. created:false contract preserved.

Root Cause #5 (backend addFcmToken) — now reads the doc first; if stored fcmTokens already includes the token it is a no-op (no write). Only when the token is new does it arrayUnion + bump updatedAt. removeFcmToken unchanged. Doc id == Firebase UID (stable identity) unchanged. Backend relative imports keep .js extensions.

New tests: backend/src/__tests__/userRepository.test.ts (vitest, mocks ../config/firebase.js with an in-memory doc that records set() calls; asserts: create sets createdAt once; unchanged email/emailVerified => 0 writes and returns existing incl. original createdAt; email change => 1 merge write without createdAt; emailVerified-only change => write; addFcmToken no-op when token present, writes arrayUnion when new or when no tokens yet). frontend/test/fcm_service_test.dart (mocktail mocks ApiClient + NotificationService, SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues; asserts: first registration POSTs and caches; unchanged cached token => no POST; changed token => POST + cache update; POST failure => token NOT cached). Verification run exactly as specified from backend/ (`npm run typecheck`, `npm test`) and frontend/ (`flutter analyze`, `flutter test`) — all green. No device testing (build + unit tests only), per constraint.
